facts.name_pl: Wybory do Sejmu Polskiej Rzeczypospolitej Ludowej
facts.name_en: Election to the Sejm of the Polish People's Republic

rules.formula: two-round majority voting; under the Round Table agreement 299 seats (65%) were reserved for PZPR and its allies and 161 (35%) were openly contested

facts.note: facts only: not on the PKW portal; seats from Party tracker

seats.name: Polska Zjednoczona Partia Robotnicza (PZPR)
seats.note: 65% (299) of seats reserved for PZPR and allied groupings; 156 district + 17 national-list seats (33 national-list seats refilled in districts on 18 June after the national list failed); contested only among candidates of the grouping

seats.name: Komitet Obywatelski „Solidarność” (non-party seats; MPs formed OKP)
seats.note: 35% (161) of seats reserved for non-party candidates and openly contested; KO 'Solidarność'-backed candidates won all 161 (160 on 4 June, 1 on 18 June)

seats.name: Zjednoczone Stronnictwo Ludowe (ZSL)
seats.note: 65% (299) of seats reserved for PZPR and allied groupings; 67 district + 9 national-list seats (33 national-list seats refilled in districts on 18 June after the national list failed); contested only among candidates of the grouping

seats.name: Stronnictwo Demokratyczne (SD)
seats.note: 65% (299) of seats reserved for PZPR and allied groupings; 24 district + 3 national-list seats (33 national-list seats refilled in districts on 18 June after the national list failed); contested only among candidates of the grouping

seats.name: Stowarzyszenie „Pax”
seats.note: 65% (299) of seats reserved for PZPR and allied groupings; 7 district + 3 national-list seats (33 national-list seats refilled in districts on 18 June after the national list failed); contested only among candidates of the grouping

seats.name: Unia Chrześcijańsko-Społeczna (UChS)
seats.note: 65% (299) of seats reserved for PZPR and allied groupings; 6 district + 2 national-list seats (33 national-list seats refilled in districts on 18 June after the national list failed); contested only among candidates of the grouping

seats.name: Polski Związek Katolicko-Społeczny (PZKS)
seats.note: 65% (299) of seats reserved for PZPR and allied groupings; 4 district + 1 national-list seats (33 national-list seats refilled in districts on 18 June after the national list failed); contested only among candidates of the grouping
